owner_choice: Automatic verification without a third-party service
scope: Signed browser work before intake, hidden trap restored in the shared form; no provider CAPTCHA, dependencies or schema changes

initial_read_only_audit.finding: Validation, Origin allowlist, Nginx rate limit and 10 saved submissions per IP/hour existed. No browser proof; active B2B form omitted the backend-supported honeypot.
initial_read_only_audit.limitation: Aggregate technical traits do not identify a particular submission as spam

deployment.rollout: Pushed code; backend upgrade in compatibility mode; atomic static release; backed-up private flag activation and restart; mandatory 403 verified

tests.disposable_postgres_delivery_and_amo: Both passed: atomicity, concurrency, fingerprints, contacts/context/UTM, private files, independent queues, rate limits, create fencing and lease/restart recovery; zero sends
tests.html_scope: All 18 HTML pages equal prior release after normalizing asset versions and removing the new hidden trap
client_cases: fresh proof and stable UUID after uncertainty

real_webcrypto_local_http_fixture.storage: Synthetic memory only; not a production delivery check

public_api.method: Released LeadClient/browserProof modules over public HTTPS; not a UI submission through the production consent checkbox

delivery.attachments: No upload field in current form; no public file uploaded. Existing valid/oversized-file unit tests and private-file PostgreSQL checks passed.

public_static.indexing_resubmission: Not applicable to form-only behavior change; actual search index not rechecked

analytics.confirmed_save_semantics: JS tests verify no success on errors and exactly-once first confirmation
analytics.sdk: Real tag.js script present on public page; no console errors
analytics.sdk_event_delivery_and_report: Unverified: browser tool does not expose network timings; no connected authenticated Metrika session used

limitations: Adds cost and blocks simple direct API submissions; an adapted bot can obtain and solve challenges. Does not prove a human visitor.
Existing tabs using the old form client must reload.
IP changes require retry; proof expires in 10 minutes.
WebCrypto required; failures preserve values and offer retry/email. Low-end physical phone performance not measured.
SMTP acceptance does not prove inbox delivery.
Real visitor data and earlier orders were not modified.
